::: {#hero-heading}
<div class="h1">Hi, I'm Imad</div>

I am a research engineer in health data science and computational methodologist building open-source tools and methodology for reproducible health research.

My work sits at the intersection of survival analysis, machine learning, missing data imputation, and agentic computation, with a focus on making advanced statistical methods accessible to health researchers. Learn more about my research in the [software packages](packages.qmd) I build.

Get in touch at [elbadisyimad@gmail.com](mailto:elbadisyimad@gmail.com) or [ielbadisy@cm6.ma](mailto:ielbadisy@cm6.ma). {{< fa feather-pointed >}}

:::

## About me

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 #about-me-1}

**Research engineer in health data science building open-source tools for reproducible research.**

I hold a PhD in Biomedical Sciences from Aix-Marseille University (SESSTIM laboratory) on missing data and machine learning methods for survival analysis. I develop software, including [survalis](https://github.com/ielbadisy/survalis) for interpretable survival machine learning, [survdnn](https://cran.r-project.org/package=survdnn) for deep survival models, and [funcml](https://github.com/ielbadisy/funcml) for functional machine learning, and design agentic workflows that bridge statistical rigor with modern computation. See my full list on the [software](packages.qmd) page.

I work at the intersection of survival analysis, machine learning, missing data, and functional data methods. Moroccan and French national, husband and father.

:::

## Research

My research develops computational methods for health data: survival machine learning (individualized prediction, neural survival models, RMST summaries, trajectory phenotyping), missing-data imputation, interpretable ML for clinical reasoning, and agentic data science for analytical workflows.

## Consulting

I provide independent methodological and statistical consulting for health research teams, from study design through publication.

- Study design and analysis plan review
- Statistical methodology (survival analysis, functional data, predictive modeling)
- Evidence synthesis
- Machine learning prediction for health outcomes
- Custom R package and tool development

Engagements are scoped individually: short advisory sessions, analysis support on a specific study, or longer-term collaboration. [Get in touch &rarr;](contact.qmd)
